messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large quadrupedal creature with the overall shape, fur, head and paws of a brown bear, shown in side view walking to the right. Its thick shaggy fur is dark brown on the back and legs and paler cream-brown on the belly and chest, with a short stub tail, two small rounded ears, a long bear muzzle with a black nose, and broad clawed paws. Fused into the fur are multiple glossy dark brown to black beetle-like exoskeleton structures, including a large ridged wing-case on the flank, a large shield over the shoulder and neck, smaller triangular plates on the back, rump and throat, and jointed bands around the upper legs and ankles, plus rows of small dark oval openings in the fur along the side and throat. A single long curved glossy black beetle horn with inner teeth and a forked tip rises from the forehead.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown bear head with long muzzle, black nose, dark eyes and shaggy brown fur", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body, facing right"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy black beetle horn curving upward with a forked tip and small inner teeth", "part": "horn", "where": "on the forehead between the eyes and ears"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head behind the horn"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy furry bear legs, dark brown with paler underparts", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry paws with long pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs"}, {"looks_like": "very short furry stub", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown ridged beetle wing-cases with black seams", "part": "shell", "where": "on the middle of the side of the torso"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown to black beetle exoskeleton plates including a large shoulder shield and smaller triangular and band-like pieces", "part": "plates", "where": "on the shoulders, back, rump, throat, and encircling the upper legs and ankles"}, {"looks_like": "rows of small dark oval spiracle-like openings", "part": "markings", "where": "along the lower side of the torso in the fur and on the throat and chest"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
